jobs.title: Doctoral Position in Generative AI-Based, Computational Design Methods for Engineering Design
jobs.description:
100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print Drucken

The Engineering Design and Computing Laboratory has a fully-funded doctoral position to work on cutting-edge research combining Large Language Models (LLMs) with formal design grammars for generative engineering design.

The starting date is in February 2027 and latest in September 2027. Applications are considered on a rolling basis until the closing date of November 01, 2026.

Job Description

Investigate new approaches in generative AI for engineering design
Explore how LLMs can act as collaborative partners for human designers
Use LLMs to Represent engineering designs, Reason about design solutions, Generate new design solutions, Explore different solution spaces
Investigate applications in Consumer products, Manufacturing, Structures
Provide teaching assistance in Engineering design, Product development, CAD

Profile

Creative and curious, with an interdisciplinary mindset
Interested in applied AI for engineering design
Interested in computational design methods
Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field
Motivated to conduct internationally leading research
Strong programming skills in Python
English is the main working language
German is an advantage but not required
Experience with computational design methods is an advantage
Experience with machine learning is an advantage
Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) is an advantage
Excellent applicants with a strong interest in research and innovation are encouraged to apply

Workplace

Workplace

We offer

Fully funded doctoral position with a competitive salary
Only a small tuition fee is required at ETH
Join a highly motivated, international team at one of Europe’s leading universities
Work in an engaging and ambitious research environment
Opportunities to collaborate with students, other research labs, industrial partners
Opportunity to shape the lab’s research direction with your own ideas
Contribute to and strengthen the lab’s international research profile

chevron_right Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich

We value diversity and sustainability

In line with our values, ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future.

Curious? So are we.

We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

CV
university transcripts for both the Bachelor and Master degree
two references that can be contacted for reference letters
Scientific publications are an advantage
a maximum of three should also be included when available

Further information about Engineering Design and Computing Laboratory can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to info-edac@mavt.ethz.ch (no applications).

Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

About ETH Zürich

ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education, cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (.NET / Azure) - On Site
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Develop, test, and maintain backend applications and services using C# and .NET on Microsoft Azure.
Contribute to the development of scalable APIs, Azure Functions, and cloud-native services.
Work with existing codebases, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements under the guidance of senior engineers.
Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and agile development processes.
Build and maintain integrations with databases, messaging systems, and other platform components.
Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, and engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Support CI/CD pipelines, deployment activities, and production monitoring efforts.
Investigate and resolve application defects, performance issues, and operational incidents.
Follow engineering best practices related to code quality, testing, security, and documentation.
Continuously learn and develop expertise in Azure cloud services and modern software engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

2-5 years of professional software development experience.
Experience developing applications using C# and .NET (.NET 6+ preferred).
Familiarity with ASP.NET Core Web APIs and backend service development.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, or Service Bus.
Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including source control and CI/CD concepts.
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies and domain knowledge.
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Good verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, and deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with Entity Framework Core and RESTful API design.
Exposure to event-driven architectures and messaging technologies.
Understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker.
Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or financial services.
Interest in cloud-native development, distributed systems, and modern architecture patterns.
Exposure to AI/ML-enabled applications, data pipelines, or analytics platforms.

Tech Stack

Languages

C#, .NET 8+

Backend

ASP.NET Core Web APIs, Azure Functions, Worker Services

Cloud

Microsoft Azure (App Services, AKS / Containers, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID / MSAL)

Data

SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Entity Framework Core

DevOps

Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD Pipelines, Docker

Observability

Application Insights, Azure Monitor

About Centific

Centific expertly engineers platforms and curates multimodal, multilingual data to empower the ‘Magnificent Seven’ and enterprise clients with safe, scalable Artificial Intelligence(AI) deployment. Our team includes over 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We leverage an integrated ecosystem comprised of industry-leading partnerships, and 1.8 million vertical domain experts across 230 locales, to create high-quality pre-trained datasets, fine-tuned industry-specific Large Language Models(LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines supported by vector databases. Our innovations can reduce Generative Artificial Intelligence(Gen AI) costs by up to 80% and bring Gen AI solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in Generative AI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by leveraging Generative AI at scale, ensuring they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

Full Stack .NET Software Developer - Vorarlberg / Hybrid

(Software Developer, .NET Developer, .NET Software Engineer, Softwareentwickler, Entwickler, Full Stack Developer, .NET Core / C#, React, TypeScript, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Elasticsearch, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, Docker, Software Developer, Full Stack Developer, Softwareentwickler, Entwickler, .NET Software Engineer, .NET Developer)

My client are a fast growing, AI driven, software and consulting company with over 30 years' experience in the software solutions market. They are seeking ambitious Full Stack .NET Software Engineers to help shape and drive forward an already established and talented development team.

Working in an Agile Scrum team, the successful candidate will play an active role in the conception, design, and development of web and backend services and be given the opportunity to contribute to the software architecture, design, and technical strategic decisions.

Strong, hands-on .NET Core (C#) expertise is required, as well as experience with modern web frontends, particularly React and TypeScript. The successful candidate will possess knowledge of CI/CD, Docker and Azure DevOps, as well as SQL Server and any experience with PostgreSQL, Node.js and Elasticsearch would be very beneficial, although training is provided.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Full Stack .NET Software Engineer to working within a challenging and supportive environment. Top performers can expect to receive their first promotion (and pay rise) within 6 months.

To apply for these positions please send your CV to Nathan Warner at Noir.

C1 German & fluent English required

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer .NET (M/W/D)*
jobs.description:
Bei TGW entwickeln wir hochautomatisierte Intralogistiklösungen für führende Unternehmen weltweit und schaffen damit die Basis für reibungslose Materialflüsse und zufriedene Kund:innen. Wenn du deine Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung in einem internationalen, innovationsgetriebenen Umfeld (Top 5 der OÖ Patentanmeldungen) einbringen möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Du willst mehr als nur Code schreiben? Bei TGW entwickelst du smarte Softwarelösungen, die weltweit Logistikprozesse revolutionieren – und das in einem Team, das Innovation und Agilität lebt.

Was man bei uns bewegt:

Gemeinsam mit Fachexpert:innen analysierst du Anforderungen und entwickelst durchdachte Konzepte.
Du designst und entwickelst moderne Anwendungen im .NET-Umfeld – mit Fokus auf Performance und Skalierbarkeit.
Du testest deine Lösungen umfassend (Unit, Integration, System) und dokumentierst sie sauber.
Bestehende Komponenten bringst du auf das nächste Level – durch Wartung, Weiterentwicklung und Performance-Tuning.
Du begleitest Inbetriebnahmen und Projekt-Rollouts – nah am Produkt, nah am Kunden.
Du coachst Kolleg:innen bei komplexen technischen Herausforderungen und teilst dein Know-how.

Was uns überzeugt:

Du hast eine technische Ausbildung (HTL, FH, Uni) mit Schwerpunkt Software Engineering oder vergleichbare Erfahrung.
Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit – idealerweise aber nicht notwendigerweise im Logistikumfeld.
Du beherrschst .NET / C# und kennst dich auch mit Oracle aus.
Du verstehst agile Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban und lebst sie im Alltag.
Du denkst konzeptionell, handelst lösungsorientiert und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein.
Du arbeitest gerne im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung und kommunizierst klar – auch auf Englisch.

Was wir bieten:

Arbeiten mit moderner IT-Ausstattung und neuesten Technologien
Großes Angebot zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung in Form von Präsenztrainings sowie eLearnings
Wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld, motivierte Teams und eine offene Feedbackkultur
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein großzügiges Home-Office-Modell
Nachhaltigkeit und Sicherheit in einem Stiftungsunternehmen: Der Großteil des Gewinns bleibt im Unternehmen und wird investiert, ein weiterer Teil fließt in gemeinnützige Projekte
Sicherer und stabiler Arbeitgeber, der entsprechend der Philosophie „Mensch im Mittelpunkt – lernen und wachsen“ agiert
